sceneCN: 这里 overlie 是「覆盖在……之上、压在上面」（第 1 个义项：上层覆盖下层）；句意：图中一层石灰岩覆盖在更深的页岩之上，是地质描述里最典型的用法。

pos.zh: 覆盖在……之上；压在……上面；位于……上层

derivatives.zh: overlie 的现在分词转形容词，义为「覆盖在上的；上覆的」，常用于描述上覆岩层或盖在上面的绳索
under（在下）+ lie（躺），义为「位于……之下；构成……的基础」，是 overlie 的上下对照词
over-（在上）+ lay（铺放）+ -er，义为「覆盖层；上覆层」，多用于技术语境
动词 overlay（铺在……之上）的过去分词，义为「被覆盖的；表面镶贴的」；注意它与 overlie 的过去式 spelling 相同，但属于另一个词
由动词 overlay 转化来的名词，义为「覆盖物；表层；覆盖层图像」

senses.title: To cover something by lying on top of it
senses.definition: to lie over something so that it covers that thing partly or completely
senses.definitionCN: 躺在某物之上，从而部分或完全盖住它
senses.example: A layer of clay overlies the gravel.
senses.exampleCN: 一层黏土覆盖在砾石之上。
senses.why: Over- marks position above, and lie supplies the flat rest of a body on the ground, so overlie pictures one flat thing resting across another.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 over- 标出「在上」的位置，lie 提供「平躺」的画面，两者合起来就是一样东西平平地盖在另一样东西上，这就是最核心的「覆盖」义。

senses.title: To be a layer above another in a sequence
senses.definition: to form an upper layer in a stack of sedimentary or artificial layers
senses.definitionCN: 在一叠沉积层或人工层中构成上方的那一层
senses.example: Younger sandstone overlies the coal seam.
senses.exampleCN: 较年轻的砂岩位于煤层之上。
senses.why: In geology, layers settle one after another, so the upper one literally lies over the older one; overlie becomes the standard word for that vertical order.
senses.whyCN: 地质上岩层一层层沉积，上面的一层确实躺在更老的一层之上，于是 overlie 自然成为描述「上覆、位于上层」这一纵向顺序的术语。

senses.title: To press on something from above
senses.definition: to weigh down on something from above, often through a second body or object
senses.definitionCN: 从上方压在某物上，常指另一具身体或物体压住
senses.example: He woke to find a heavy blanket overlying his legs.
senses.exampleCN: 他醒来时发现腿上压着一条厚毯子。
senses.why: A thing lying on another is also pressing on it, so the static cover sense extends to the felt weight of whatever lies on top.
senses.whyCN: 东西躺在另一样东西上面，也就等于压着它，所以静态的「覆盖」义可以延伸出「压在上面」的重量感。

senses.title: To be a thin film spread over a surface
senses.titleCN: 薄薄覆在表面；蒙上一层
senses.definition: to be spread as a thin sheet or film over a surface
senses.definitionCN: 以薄膜或薄层的形式铺盖在表面之上
senses.example: A film of oil overlays the water near the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 港口附近的水面覆着一层油膜。
senses.why: The covering need not be heavy; anything that spreads and stays on top uses the same image, from thin films to letters lying over a page.
senses.whyCN: 盖住的东西不必厚重，凡是铺开并停留在表面的东西都能套用这个画面，从油膜到覆在纸页上的字迹都属于这一义。

senses.title: To hide the thing below
senses.definition: to prevent something beneath from being seen, so that only the top layer shows
senses.definitionCN: 使下面的东西看不见，只能看到上面这一层
senses.example: Dust overlies the carved letters of the plaque.
senses.exampleCN: 尘土覆在牌匾的刻字上，字迹被遮住了。
senses.why: If one thing lies entirely across another, the lower one disappears from view; covering and hiding are the same physical event seen from two sides.
senses.whyCN: 一样东西完整地横在另一样东西上面时，下面那一层就从视线里消失了，「遮挡」只是同一动作从被盖者角度出发的说法。

senses.title: To rest over something throughout a period
senses.definition: to lie over a place or a period in a lasting way, such as an atmosphere or a period of rule
senses.definitionCN: 长时间地笼罩某个地方或时期，如气氛、统治时期
senses.example: A sense of fear overlaid the town for weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 一种恐惧的气氛笼罩了小镇好几个星期。
senses.why: The spatial image is reused for time: an unwanted feeling lies over a place the way a cloud lies over land, giving the sense of a mood that hangs above.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的画面可以移用到时间上：乌云压着大地，也就成了某种气氛长期笼罩某地，于是有了「长期压在上面」的比喻义。

intro.en: Overlie is formed inside English from the prefix over- and the verb lie, whose older form goes back to Old English licgan.
intro.cn: overlie 是英语内部构词：前缀 over- 加上动词 lie，后者承自古英语 licgan。

items.en: A reconstructed root, usually cited as ligjan, supplies the ancestors of English lie and German liegen.
items.cn: 一般认为，重构形式 ligjan 是英语 lie 与德语 liegen 的共同祖先（重构形式，属于推断）。

items.en: The verb licgan means to be in a flat position on the ground, and to lie as opposed to sit or stand.
items.cn: 古英语 licgan 意为「横躺着」，即与坐、立相对的「躺」。

items.en: The prefix ofer- already means over or above, as in oferlicgan, a covering made by lying across something.
items.cn: 古英语中 oferlicgan 已表示「躺在……之上把它盖住」，说明组合方式早已出现。

items.en: Over- and lie combine in spellings such as overliggen and overlie, used of things lying on top of others.
items.cn: 中古英语里 over- 与 lie 拼合，出现 overliggen、overlie 等形式，表示「覆盖在上面」。

items.en: The verb settles into the spelling overlie with a strong technical use in mining and the study of rock layers.
items.cn: 早期现代英语把它定型为 overlie，并在采矿与岩层研究中形成稳固的技术用法。

items.en: Geology makes overlie a standard term for a layer above another, alongside the adjective overlying.
items.cn: 现代英语中，overlie 成为地质学里「上覆」的规范术语，并衍生出常用的形容词 overlying。

note.en: Overlie sits with the lie family that singles out position, and is often confused with overlay, a different verb that can share the past form overlay.
note.cn: overlie 与同样强调位置的 lie 词族相邻，也常与另一个动词 overlay 混淆，两者过去式拼写相同。

entries.definition: to be in a flat resting position
entries.definitionCN: lie 义为「躺；平放」，是 overlie 的基础动词，本身不表示覆盖。

entries.definition: to be below or to be the basis of
entries.definitionCN: underlie 与 overlie 上下相对，义为「位于之下；构成基础」。

entries.definition: to spread something over something else
entries.definitionCN: overlay 义为「铺盖在……之上」，与 overlie 只是拼写相近，词源来自 lay 而非 lie；它的过去式恰好也写作 overlay。

entries.definition: to cover part of the same area
entries.definitionCN: overlap 义为「部分重叠」，与 overlie 同带 over-，但核心是「交叠」而不是「在上覆盖」。

entries.definition: to place something over something else
entries.definitionCN: cover 义为「覆盖；盖住」，是 overlie 最通用的近义词。

entries.definition: to sit on top of something
entries.definitionCN: cap 义为「位于……之上；封顶」，多用于山峰或岩层的上盖部分。

entries.definition: to be supported by something under it
entries.definitionCN: rest on 义为「架在……上；依托于」，强调上方的支撑关系。

entries.definition: to cover and hide from view
entries.definitionCN: shroud 义为「遮蔽；覆盖」，书卷气浓，与 overlie 的掩藏义相近。

normalIntro.en: Overlie is over- plus lie, so it just means a flat thing lying across another flat thing; geology borrowed this plain picture for rock layers.
normalIntro.cn: overlie 就是 over- 加 lie，意思是平平地躺压在另一样东西上；地质学借用了这个朴素的画面来讲岩层。

normal.en: Lie changes to lies, lay, lain through the present, past and past participle of overlie.
normal.cn: overlie 随 lie 变形，依次是 overlies、overlay、overlain，过去式与 overlay 这个词同形。

normal.en: Lie with an object is lay; overlie never takes an object that way because over- already marks position.
normal.cn: lie 表示「放置」时的不及物变体是 lay；overlie 因 over- 已标出位置，不需要另拆 lie 与 lay。

normal.en: Geologists say that one bed overlies another and that the upper bed is overlying.
normal.cn: 地质学家说岩层 A 覆盖在岩层 B 之上，上面的那层就用形容词 overlying。

normal.en: Compare overlie with underlie: the prefix decides who is on top.
normal.cn: 把 overlie 与 underlie 对照记，前缀决定谁在上面。

normal.en: The passive form be overlain by is common in technical writing.
normal.cn: 被动结构 be overlain by 在技术写作里很常见。

abstract.en: Lay one page over another: the second page lies on top, so it overlies the first.
abstract.cn: 把一页纸盖在另一页上：上面那张就是「覆盖」着下面那张。

abstract.en: Imagine a blanket smoothed across a bed and hiding the sheet beneath.
abstract.cn: 想象一条毯子抹平在床面上，把下面的床单完全遮住。

abstract.en: See the sky pressing down as a single grey lid over the town.
abstract.cn: 把天空想成扣在小镇上方的一块灰色盖子。

examples.en: The granite overlies a much older band of schist.
examples.cn: 花岗岩位于一条古老得多的片岩带之上。

examples.en: Thick grass overlies the roots, so the path is invisible.
examples.cn: 厚厚的草盖住了树根，小路完全看不见。

examples.en: The ancient city lies buried beneath layers of soil that overlie the river plain.
examples.cn: 这座古城埋在被河水冲积平原所覆盖的层层土壤之下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧窝来」——在欧洲的窝里，毯子从上面盖下来，就是「覆盖在上」；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语内部构词：前缀 over-（源自古英语 ofer，意为「在上、越过」）+ 动词 lie（源自古英语 licgan，与德语 liegen 同源，意为「躺平」）。古英语已有 oferlicgan 表示「躺在……之上盖住」，中古英语定型为 overlie，现代英语在地质学中成为「上覆」的规范术语。

sensesIntro.en: Overlie starts from a plain flat covering, extends to the ordered layers of rock and thin films, and then to hiding, duration and the atmosphere of a place.
sensesIntro.cn: overlie 从「平平地盖在上面」出发，延伸到岩层与薄膜的有序叠置，再到掩藏、时期笼罩与气氛压顶等义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat sheet resting across another surface and covering it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张平铺的薄片横在另一面上并盖住它。

branches.en: A physical cover and its weight are the basic senses.
branches.cn: 实体覆盖与压在上面的重量是最基本的义项。

branches.en: Ordered layers and thin films show the covering at different scales.
branches.cn: 有序岩层与薄膜显示「覆盖」在不同尺度上的应用。

branches.en: Hiding is the same cover seen from the side of what is beneath.
branches.cn: 掩藏是从被盖者的角度看同一个覆盖动作。

branches.en: Lasting over a place or period stretches the plain picture into time.
branches.cn: 长期笼罩把朴素的空间画面延伸到了时间上。

branches.en: All three keep the idea of one thing genuinely lying across another.
branches.cn: 这三个义项都保留「一样东西确实横在另一样东西上面」的底层意思。

intro.en: Overlie is an English compound of the prefix over- and the verb lie, with its technical sense coming clearly from the spatial picture of one layer lying on another.
intro.cn: overlie 是前缀 over- 与动词 lie 构成的英语复合词，它的技术义直接来自「一层躺在另一层上」的空间画面。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root here, since overlie is a native English formation from Old English ofer and licgan.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语词根，因为 overlie 是由古英语 ofer 与 licgan 构成的英语本族合成词。

items.example: Over- in overlie fixes the upper position.
items.exampleCN: overlie 中的 over- 固定了「在上方」的位置。

items.meaning: to be in a flat position
items.example: Lie gives the flat resting picture.
items.exampleCN: lie 提供「平躺」的画面。

items.example: Ofer- is the Old English ancestor of the prefix.
items.exampleCN: ofer- 是该前缀的古英语祖先。

items.example: Licgan is the Old English form of lie.
items.exampleCN: licgan 是 lie 的古英语形式。

items.example: The root is reconstructed and not directly attested.
items.exampleCN: 这一词根是重构形式，并无直接文献记录。

items.meaning: to spread over; a covering layer
items.example: Overlay comes from lay, not from lie.
items.exampleCN: overlay 源自 lay，而非 lie。

items.example: Overlying adds -ing to the present participle.
items.exampleCN: overlying 由现在分词加 -ing 形成。

items.example: Underlie pairs with overlie in the vertical image.
items.exampleCN: underlie 与 overlie 在纵向画面上相互对应。

items.meaning: a layer that lies over something
items.example: Overlayer builds on overlay with -er.
items.exampleCN: overlayer 由 overlay 加 -er 构成。

items.meaningCN: 现在分词或形容词词尾
items.example: The suffix -ing makes the adjective overlying.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成形容词 overlying。

definition_zh: 高估；把……估计过高；评价过高
definition_en: to think that someone or something is better, bigger or more important than it really is
core_image: 在天平一端悄悄加砝码，把数字刻度拨过头
scene: 评奖结果公布前，网上有人把小成本电影捧得极高，放映后观众却很失望。Many critics overrate films that look impressive at first glance.
sceneCN: 这里 overrate 是「高估、评价过高」（第 1 个义项：对真实水平的估计超出实际）；句意：许多影评人把第一眼看上去就惊艳的影片评价得过高，属于常见的误判用法。

pos.zh: 高估；把……估计过高；评价过高

derivatives.zh: over- 表「过度」加 rate 的过去分词，义为「被高估的；被吹捧过头的」，日常口语使用极广
由动词 rate 加 -ing 构成，义为「评分；评级」，overrate 是在这个评价动作上再加「过度」
现在分词转化为名词，义为「过高评价；高估行为」
基础动词，义为「评估；评级」，overrate 去掉前缀即得
under-（不足）加 rate（评价），义为「低估」，与 overrate 构成反义对

senses.title: To value someone higher than they deserve
senses.definition: to place a higher value on a person or thing than is accurate
senses.definitionCN: 对人或事物的评价高于其真实价值
senses.example: The manager overrates the young striker.
senses.exampleCN: 主教练高估了这名年轻前锋。
senses.why: Rate means to estimate the value of something, and over- means too much, so overrate is simply to put the estimate above the true level.
senses.whyCN: rate 意为「评估价值」，over- 表示「过度」，所以 overrate 就是把评估的数字拨到真实水平之上，得到最核心的「评价过高」义。

senses.title: To expect more from something than it can do
senses.definition: to believe that someone or something can do more than is really possible
senses.definitionCN: 相信某人或某物能做到实际做不到的事
senses.example: Never overrate the patience of a beginner.
senses.exampleCN: 永远不要高估新手的耐心。
senses.why: Rates can measure performance rather than price, so overrating a person pictures a measuring stick stretched past their actual reach.
senses.whyCN: rate 也可以衡量表现而不只是价钱，所以高估一个人的表现，就是把他能力的刻度尺拉到超出实际的位置。

senses.title: To think a risk or problem bigger than it is
senses.titleCN: 高估风险；夸大严重程度
senses.definition: to judge the size, danger or seriousness of something to be greater than it is
senses.definitionCN: 把某物的规模、危险或严重程度判断得比实际更大
senses.example: Do not overrate the danger of travelling by night bus.
senses.exampleCN: 不要高估夜班车的危险。
senses.why: Since over- marks an amount above the true one, risks and numbers are also exaggerated upward, which makes people worry more than they need.
senses.whyCN: over- 表示「超过真实数量」，所以风险与数字同样会被向上夸大，造成不必要的担忧，这是高估量级的一义。

senses.title: To belong to an overrated reputation
senses.definition: used of a person or work whose fame is wider than its true worth
senses.definitionCN: 用于描述名气超过真实价值的人或作品
senses.example: The hotel is overrated and its view is the only real asset.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒店名过其实，真正拿得出手的只有风景。
senses.why: When people overrate something, the judgement sticks to the thing, and the past participle overrated becomes the adjective for a reputation out of proportion to its worth.
senses.whyCN: 一旦大家对某物评价过高，这个判断就固定在该物身上，过去分词 overrated 便成了形容「名过其实」的形容词。

senses.title: To count more than it should
senses.definition: to give something a larger share of attention or importance than it merit
senses.definitionCN: 给予某事物超出其应得的注意力或重要性
senses.example: Many parents overrate examination results.
senses.exampleCN: 许多家长把考试成绩看得过重。
senses.why: Rating an item means ranking it, so overrating shifts the item upward in the ranking of what matters, giving the sense of putting too much weight on it.
senses.whyCN: 给某物打分也就是给它排序，高估就等于把它的重要程度往上挪，于是有了「看得过重」这一义。

senses.title: To speak of something as greater than it is
senses.titleCN: 把……说得过了头；夸张评价
senses.definition: to describe or advertise something as more impressive than it really is
senses.definitionCN: 把某物描述或宣传得比实际更令人惊叹
senses.example: The brochure overrates the size of the rooms.
senses.exampleCN: 宣传册把房间面积说得过了头。
senses.why: A value placed on something is also a statement about it, so an overstated estimate turns into an exaggerated description in speech or advertising.
senses.whyCN: 对某物的估值同时也是关于它的一句话，于是夸张的评价就变成了在言语或广告中把东西说得过了头。

intro.en: Overrate joins the English prefix over- to the verb rate, which goes back through Old French to Medieval Latin rata, a fixed portion.
intro.cn: overrate 由英语前缀 over- 与动词 rate 组合而成；rate 经古法语上溯到中世纪拉丁语 rata（固定的份额）。

items.en: Rata means a fixed share or a settled amount, as in pro rata, according to the share.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 rata 意为「固定的份额或确定的数量」，习语 pro rata 即「按比例」。

items.en: Rata is a form of ratus or reri, meaning settled, reckoned or thought of.
items.cn: rata 是 ratus（确定的、计算过的）或 reri（思量、计算）的形式，一般认为与词义演变有关。

items.en: Rate enters English through French forms for a fixed amount or a set price.
items.cn: 英语 rate 经由法语形式进入，原指「定额；固定价格」。

items.en: Rate first names a proportion or a charge, and then develops the verb sense of estimating worth.
items.cn: 中古英语 rate 先指「比例、费率」，随后发展出动词义「估值；评级」。

items.en: The Old English prefix over- is added to the verb, giving overrate, first recorded in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 十七世纪时，源自古英语的前缀 over- 加在这个借词动词上，形成 overrate，并首次被记录。

items.en: The past participle overrated turns into a popular adjective for anything praised beyond its worth.
items.cn: 现代英语里，过去分词 overrated 成了形容「被捧得过头」的流行形容词。

note.en: Overrate is the prefix over- laid on the verb rate, and it works against underrate while sitting near exaggerate and idealise.
note.cn: overrate 是前缀 over- 加在动词 rate 上，它与 underrate 正相对，意义上又与 exaggerate、idealise 相邻。

entries.definition: to judge the value of something
entries.definitionCN: rate 义为「评估；评级」，是 overrate 的基础动词。

entries.definition: to think too little of
entries.definitionCN: underrate 与 overrate 正相对，义为「低估」。

entries.definition: too much; excessively
entries.definitionCN: overly 与 overrate 同用 over- 表「过度」；只是拼写相近，两者并不同源。

entries.definition: to pass someone who is moving
entries.definitionCN: overtake 同带 over-，义为「超过」，与 overrate 构词方式平行而已。

entries.definition: to describe something as larger than it is
entries.definitionCN: exaggerate 义为「夸大」，多用于描述语言上的渲染。

entries.definition: to guess a value as too high
entries.definitionCN: overestimate 义为「高估」，多指数值或数量的估算偏高。

entries.definition: to make something seem bigger
entries.definitionCN: inflate 义为「吹高；夸大」，强调把效果凭空吹大。

entries.definition: to think of as perfect
entries.definitionCN: idealise 义为「理想化」，强调把对象想得完美无缺。

normalIntro.en: Overrate is over- on the verb rate: the act of judging a value and then pushing that judgement too high.
normalIntro.cn: overrate 就是把 over- 加在动词 rate 上：先评估价值，再把评估结果推得过高。

normal.en: Over- in overrate, overdo and overstated all mark excess in judging.
normal.cn: overrate、overdo、overstated 中的 over- 都标出「判断上的过度」。

normal.en: Underrate is the direct opposite, built with under- instead of over-.
normal.cn: underrate 是直接反义，把 over- 换成 under- 即可。

normal.en: The adjective overrated is far more frequent than the verb in speech.
normal.cn: 口语里形容词 overrated 远比动词常用。

normal.en: Rate on its own means to judge the value; overrate only raises that judgement.
normal.cn: rate 本身只是「评估价值」，overrate 则是把这个评估抬高。

normal.en: Compare overrate with overestimate: the first judges quality, the second guesses a number.
normal.cn: 对比 overrate 与 overestimate：前者评价好坏，后者估算数字。

abstract.en: Picture a hand nudging the needle of a scale past the true mark.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把秤上的指针悄悄推过真实的刻度。

abstract.en: Think of a price tag with an extra nought written on it.
abstract.cn: 想象价签上被人多加了一个零。

abstract.en: Imagine a crown placed on a cardboard throne, far too big for it.
abstract.cn: 想象一顶过大的王冠戴在纸糊的王座上。

examples.en: Nobody overrates the value of sleep more than a student before an exam.
examples.cn: 考试前没有谁比学生更懂得把睡眠的价值往高里想。

examples.en: The novel was greatly overrated when it first appeared.
examples.cn: 这部小说刚出版时被大大高估了。

examples.en: Critics tend to overrate originality and ignore patient craft.
examples.cn: 评论家往往高估独创性，却忽视踏实的技艺。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧窝瑞特」——「瑞」字听着吉祥，就把评价往高分上调，结果超了实际，就是「高估」；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语内部构词：前缀 over-（源自古英语 ofer，意为「在上、过度」）+ 动词 rate（借自古法语，上溯中世纪拉丁语 rata「固定的份额」，与拉丁语 reri「思量」相关）。十七世纪时英语把本族前缀加到借词动词上，形成 overrate。

sensesIntro.en: Overrate starts from judging a person or thing above its worth, then stretches to expect too much, inflate risks, brand something as overrated, and weight it too heavily in importance.
sensesIntro.cn: overrate 从对人、对物的评价过高出发，再延伸出对能力期望过高、夸大风险、贴上名过其实的标签，以及把重要性看得过重等义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a value needle pushed past the true mark on a scale.
core.cn: 核心意象：秤上的数值指针被推过真实刻度。

branches.en: Judging value too high is the central sense.
branches.cn: 把价值估得过高是中心的义项。

branches.en: Expecting more ability and bigger danger both stretch the same upward guess.
branches.cn: 期望更高的能力与更大的危险，都是同一个向上推测的延伸。

branches.en: The judgement becomes a label on the thing itself.
branches.cn: 评价固定下来，就成了贴在事物身上的标签。

branches.en: Importance gains extra weight in the ranking of what matters.
branches.cn: 重要性在价值排序里被加重了分量。

branches.en: Saying something is greater than it is puts the overrated valuation into words.
branches.cn: 把东西说得比实际更强，是高估的估价落到了言词上。

intro.en: Overrate is the prefix over- plus the borrowed verb rate, and its most familiar shape today is the adjective overrated.
intro.cn: overrate 是前缀 over- 加上借入动词 rate，如今最常见的形式是形容词 overrated。

latinIntro.en: The rate part comes through Old French from Medieval Latin rata, a fixed share, related to Latin ratus and reri.
latinIntro.cn: rate 这一部分经古法语来自中世纪拉丁语 rata（固定份额），与拉丁语 ratus、reri（计算、思量）相关。

items.example: Over- in overrate means an estimate set too high.
items.exampleCN: overrate 中的 over- 表示把估值定得过高。

items.meaning: to evaluate or judge the worth
items.example: Rate supplies the act of judging value.
items.exampleCN: rate 提供「评估价值」的动作。

items.meaning: a fixed share, a settled amount
items.example: Rata is the source of the amount sense of rate.
items.exampleCN: rata 是 rate 中「定额」义的来源。

items.example: Ratus is linked to the verb of reckoning.
items.exampleCN: ratus 与「计算」的动词同源。

items.example: Reri carries the idea of reckoning.
items.exampleCN: reri 带有「计算、思量」的意思。

items.example: Underrate reverses overrate with under-.
items.exampleCN: underrate 用 under- 构成 overrate 的反义。

items.meaningCN: 被高估的；被吹捧过头的
items.example: Overrated adds -ed to the verb overrate.
items.exampleCN: overrated 由动词 overrate 加 -ed 构成。

items.example: The suffix -ed makes the participial adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成分词形容词。

items.example: Overrating turns the participle into a noun.
items.exampleCN: overrating 把分词转成名词。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms the action noun.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成表示动作的名词。
